about_the_game: “On the day of what she believed to be her ‘Happy ending’, Cinderella witnesses the collapse of her universe and the murder of her beloved. With the help of a magic grimoire, in search of the truth, she walks into various fairy tales, through worlds that are now disturbing and enigmatic. Fighting enemies corrupted by a strange curse, the princess becomes a mighty warrior, determined to resolve this chaos.”

short_description: A dark fantasy adventure in Cinderella Chronicles. Use magic and wield a bloodthirsty shoe sword to battle corrupted enemies, transcend into badass mode, and solve puzzles with sidekicks. Unravel the truth behind a mysterious curse and embark on an epic journey to save the tales from darkness !
